source: Kandoth et al. 2013 Nature 497:67-73, exome analysis section; 17 POLE-ultramutated tumours of 248 sequenced; hotspots P286R/V411L in 13 of 17
interpretation: The m=3->1 prediction (6944x) overshoots the observed ~80x by ~87x: refuted as a quantitative claim. A single-stage loss (1/gamma = 83.3x) is within 4% of the observed ratio; this is a post-hoc observation on one data point, not a confirmation.
